# image_vision v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

> Simple image classification, embedding, object detection,
segmentation, background removal, captioning, and zero-shot
classification for the `image` library. Powered by Bumblebee and
Ortex with strong, permissively-licensed defaults — no ML
expertise required.

- [ImageVision](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Image.Background](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/Image.Background.md): Foreground/background separation — "remove the background from
this image".
- [Image.Captioning](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/Image.Captioning.md): Image captioning — generates a natural-language description of an
image.
- [Image.Classification](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/Image.Classification.md): Image classification — what's in this image?
- [Image.Detection](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/Image.Detection.md): Object detection — where are the objects in this image?
- [Image.FaceDetection](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/Image.FaceDetection.md): Face detection — where are the faces in this image?
- [Image.Segmentation](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/Image.Segmentation.md): Image segmentation — which pixels belong to which object?
- [Image.ZeroShot](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/Image.ZeroShot.md): Zero-shot image classification — classify an image against
arbitrary labels you supply at call time, without retraining.
- [ImageVision](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/ImageVision.md): `ImageVision` provides simple, opinionated image vision operations
that sit alongside the [`image`](https://hex.pm/packages/image)
library
- [ImageVision.ModelCache](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/ImageVision.ModelCache.md): On-disk cache for ONNX model weights downloaded from
[HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co).

## Mix Tasks

- [mix image_vision.download_models](https://image-vision.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ImageVision.DownloadModels.md): Pre-downloads the default models used by `Image.Classification`,
`Image.Segmentation`, `Image.Detection`, `Image.Background`,
`Image.Captioning`, and `Image.ZeroShot` so that first-call latency
is eliminated and the application can run fully offline.
